runtimeObservation.source: parent-reported; historical observation, verify live before use

reportingRules: One coordinated browser effect owner; concurrent analysis must not mutate the shared browser.
Objectives are assigned and reported sequentially, one at a time; this ledger is not a browser campaign.
Effects require scoped authorization; preserve the original operation identity and reconcile uncertainty read-only, with no blind resends.
Do not record sensitive raw output, credentials, private conversations, or raw captures; use safe evidence references.
Never invent success: report only observed outcomes and distinguish unavailable account features from unsupported harness capabilities.
Attempts are append-only; objective status is NOT_TESTED when attempts is empty, otherwise it derives from the latest appended attempt status.

objectives.title: Account identity
objectives.objective: Identify which ChatGPT account is signed in without exposing personal credentials.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Identify which ChatGPT account is signed in without exposing personal credentials' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Account identity not determined; status said unverified, target had unverified thread identity, recipe selection no-match, and catalog offered no account identity inspection.
attempts.friction: No native account identity inspection action discovered; target metadata does not establish authentication.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only; no sends, navigation, account changes, or draft modifications.
attempts.uncertainty: Authentication state and identity unknown; elapsed time was not measured.

objectives.title: Authentication state
objectives.objective: Detect whether ChatGPT is signed out and requires login.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Detect whether ChatGPT is signed out and requires login' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Recipe selection returned no-match. A live read-only chat_index inspection of the ChatGPT root found 18 visible candidate thread links, but did not report authentication or whether login is required. Candidate links alone do not establish authentication.
attempts.friction: No native authentication-state or login-prompt inspection action was discovered; chat_index returns links, not auth state.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only; no sends, navigation, account changes, or draft modifications.
attempts.uncertainty: Signed-in versus signed-out and need for human login remain unverified.

objectives.title: Native thread identity
objectives.objective: Identify the currently visible native conversation ID, not its title.

attempts.observedOutcome: The sole reported ChatGPT target is at https://chatgpt.com with thread null, identity unverified and reason UNSUPPORTED_PATH; visibility is unknown. No native conversation ID was identified. The root URL does not establish an active /c/ thread.
attempts.friction: The target is at the root rather than an exact thread path; the read-only scope prohibits navigating to one. The tool reports visibility unknown, so it cannot prove which tab is currently visible.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only inspection only; no navigation, sends, account or settings changes, or draft modifications.
attempts.uncertainty: Whether a thread is visually active cannot be established from the reported root URL and unknown visibility. The shell had a 15-second timeout but no independently enforced per-process remaining-time kill; the invocation finished well before the deadline.

objectives.title: Tab discovery
objectives.objective: Locate the ChatGPT tab among unrelated webapp tabs.

attempts.observedOutcome: The Studio conversation_targets result identified one ChatGPT target, FAADCCF91BD85A1179F30D9111143CF7, and no other targets. The sites list is a provider catalog, not evidence of other open tabs. A broader native targets command returned ENVIRONMENT / BROWSER_PROFILE_UNVERIFIED, so unrelated tabs could not be verified.
attempts.friction: No unrelated webapp target was observed; broader target enumeration refused to attach because browser profile identity was not verified by that command, despite the parent-reported earlier launch verification. No tabs were created or navigated.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only inspection only; no navigation, sends, account or settings changes, or draft modifications.
attempts.uncertainty: The ChatGPT target was located, but discovery among unrelated open tabs was not demonstrated; other browser tabs may exist. Each CLI call started with at least 15 seconds remaining and the enclosing shell had a 15-second timeout; no independent per-process deadline kill was verified.

objectives.title: Chrome-profile isolation
objectives.objective: Recognize which ChatGPT window belongs to the dedicated VIVIM profile.

attempts.observedOutcome: Studio status identified dataDir C:\VIVIM, intended chromeProfile C:\VIVIM\chrome-profile and CDP port 38702 but explicitly said profile not proven by status. The native capture-browser targets command with the explicit data directory succeeded and listed ChatGPT target FAADCCF91BD85A1179F30D9111143CF7, matching Studio conversation_targets. In objective 004 the same command without that data directory failed profile verification. Parent had separately reported a verified launch for this profile.
attempts.friction: Doctor without explicit data-dir used a different default local data directory. The targets command needs --data-dir C:\VIVIM to use the intended profile context; status alone does not prove identity.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only native CLI inspection only; no browser or server restart, navigation, sends, account or settings changes, or draft modifications.
attempts.uncertainty: The successful guarded targets command identifies the ChatGPT target in the dedicated capture browser, not an operating-system window handle or signed-in account. Profile verification is inferred from the command's documented capture-browser behavior and earlier explicit unverified-profile refusal, not an explicit verified flag in this command output. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; no independent process-kill enforcement was verified.

objectives.title: Page readiness
objectives.objective: Tell me whether ChatGPT is ready to accept input or still loading.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Tell whether ChatGPT is ready to accept input or still loading' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Recipe choice returned no-match. Native CLI help exposed no dedicated read-only page-readiness command. Live chat_index observed rendered links on the ChatGPT root page, but reports no loading, composer, or input-readiness state; rendered links are not proof that input is ready.
attempts.friction: No discoverable read-only readiness inspection for the existing root target; the previously discovered live transcript tool requires an exact-bound conversation and does not establish root composer readiness.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only inspection only; no navigation, sends, composer typing, settings or account changes.
attempts.uncertainty: Whether input is ready or the page is still loading remains unknown. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only native CLI inspection only; no navigation, sends, typing, settings or account changes.

objectives.title: Ephemeral chat awareness
objectives.objective: Recognize when ChatGPT is in Temporary Chat mode.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Recognize whether the current ChatGPT page is in Temporary Chat mode' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Recipe selection suggested provider.chat-index based on vocabulary overlap only. The live read-only chat_index inspected currently rendered links on the ChatGPT root but exposed no Temporary Chat mode field or indication; it did not establish whether the mode is enabled or disabled.
attempts.friction: The suggested chat index is a link index, not a Temporary Chat state inspector; no dedicated native read-only mode inspection was found in the previously examined catalog.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only native CLI inspection only; no navigation, sends, typing, settings or account changes.
attempts.uncertainty: Temporary Chat mode remains unknown; absence of a mode field does not mean it is off. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

objectives.title: Duplicate-title identity
objectives.objective: Disambiguate two native threads with identical visible titles.

attempts.observedOutcome: The live index returned 18 distinct candidate thread paths from 18 visible thread links, none omitted and none title-truncated. Each displayTitle object contained only untrusted and truncated flags, with no title text; a duplicate-title pair therefore could not be identified or ruled out. All entries were candidates, not live-bound threads.
attempts.friction: The native response omitted actual visible title text despite a 300-character limit, preventing title equality comparison. The index is incomplete and does not establish live thread bindings.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only native CLI inspection only; no creation, renaming, navigation, sends or draft changes.
attempts.uncertainty: Presence or absence of duplicate visible titles remains unknown; no duplicate pair was proven. Invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

objectives.title: UI obstruction recognition
objectives.objective: Explain why the ChatGPT composer is blocked by a modal or challenge.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Explain whether the ChatGPT composer is blocked by a modal or challenge' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Recipe choice returned no-match. Live target metadata reported the ChatGPT root target with unknown visibility, but no composer, modal or challenge information. No obstruction or absence of obstruction was established.
attempts.friction: No dedicated read-only composer obstruction or challenge inspection action was exposed by the previously examined native catalog; target metadata does not inspect the UI.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only inspection only; no clicks, dismissal, navigation, typing, sends, or account or settings changes.
attempts.uncertainty: Whether the composer is blocked, and any cause, remains unknown. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

objectives.title: New-chat navigation
objectives.objective: Open a blank new conversation without sending anything.

attempts.observedOutcome: create_conversation returned a new ChatGPT target 9A3D0AAE522702601545ED3CCDAE2F5E and local conversation 1c9ab74a-605d-495b-8e1b-048f30765996, identity unbound NEW_CHAT and no recorded turns; it also reported state blocked, readiness false, reason BINDING_CHANGED. A subsequent target listing showed the new root target and the original target still present. No send was made. Blank composer or readiness was not verified.
attempts.friction: Creation returned BINDING_CHANGED and blocked readiness. Creation binding reported ownedByStudio true while subsequent target metadata reported false, so ownership and suitability for subsequent actions require revalidation. Root URL and empty local turns do not prove a blank usable composer.
attempts.authorizationScope: Create a new disposable ChatGPT tab through the existing owner only; no navigation of the original target, sends, typing, settings or account changes.
attempts.uncertainty: The original target remains listed but draft preservation was not independently inspected. The new tab's composer and visibility are unknown, and its ownership metadata conflicts. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

objectives.title: Sidebar history selection
objectives.objective: Locate a particular conversation in the history sidebar by its title.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Locate a particular conversation in the history sidebar by title' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: Recipe choice returned no-match. Live chat_index returned 18 candidate thread links with no entries omitted and no reported title truncation, but displayTitle objects contained flags only and no title text. No conversation was located by title.
attempts.friction: Native index did not expose title text or sidebar container identity; no particular approved disposable test title was supplied or established. The title-observation capability gap and missing target precondition are distinct limitations.
attempts.authorizationScope: Read-only inspection only; no private thread opening, navigation, sends, typing, renaming or settings changes.
attempts.uncertainty: A matching disposable title may or may not be present; the returned title-free, incomplete candidate index cannot establish it. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.

objectives.title: Deep-link navigation
objectives.objective: Open a conversation from its exact native /c/ address.

commands: node bin/studio.mjs recipe choose --intent 'Open an exact ChatGPT conversation link in a disposable tab without sending' --json
attempts.observedOutcome: The permitted source-map live-evidence section identifies an exact prior disposable test thread. Recipe discovery returned no-match. Live target discovery showed only two root ChatGPT targets, both with null thread and unverified identity; it did not show the test thread open. No navigation was performed or proven.
attempts.friction: No native existing-owner action was discovered that opens an exact URL without sending or navigating a protected tab. The previously discovered connect tool requires an already-open exact thread. The new disposable target's ownership and binding remain unverified; it was not used for navigation.
attempts.authorizationScope: Navigation only on a verified disposable tab or fresh owned disposable tab, no sends or private thread exploration; actual actions were read-only.
attempts.uncertainty: The historical test thread's current availability is unknown. No current URL or successful navigation to it was observed. Each invocation began with at least 15 seconds remaining and used a 15-second shell timeout; independent process-kill enforcement was not verified.
